first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Near-foreground person holding a handgun, with short brown hair, wearing a dark blue-gray top and brown trousers, with a brown shoulder strap and a holster at the waist.

entities.name: green foreground counter
entities.identification: The turquoise wooden counter in front of Person A, with worn paint and bag-shaped goods, bottles, jars, and a gray device on the countertop.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: The red rectangular shop stall on the image-right side of the passageway, equipped with a gray roller shutter, a large red pattern, and side windowpanes.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: The gray-brown flagstone path extending from the foreground to the blue-and-white steps, with water surfaces and reflections in places.

entities.name: distant curved building
entities.identification: The light-colored multistory building above and behind the shop stall, with a curved corner and green balcony edges.

entities.name: armed person near the steps
entities.identification: The group of distant people holding guns near the steps and beside the fruit table, excluding Person A and Person C.

entities.name: green open goods stall
entities.identification: The partial green stall structure at the far image-right edge in frame 0, showing a lower panel, diagonal brace, and dark vertical bars inside.

entities.name: orange-fruit table
entities.identification: The low orange wooden display table in front of the red shop stall, with a front composed of horizontal slats.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: The multiple broad steps at the far end of the passageway, with light-gray treads and blue-and-white segmented risers.

entities.name: raised market hall
entities.identification: The brownish-red, sloped-roof building at the upper image-left indicated by the source static item, identifiable by its dark projecting eaves and the roof behind the stall rack.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The silver-gray short handgun held by Person A, initially beside the knee and later raised toward the far end of the passageway.

entities.name: sky between the buildings
entities.identification: The light-blue sky and pale white clouds visible between the roofs.

entities.name: surrounding market buildings
entities.identification: The group of ordinary buildings on both sides of and behind the passageway, excluding the separately listed shop stall, curved building, and market hall.

entities.name: hanging green plants along the building edge
entities.identification: Clusters of green leaves hanging downward from the balcony and building edge in the upper image-right.

entities.name: light-colored cloth bag
entities.identification: The group of bulging beige-gray bag-shaped goods on the counter and the stall rack on the image-left.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: The group of yellow-green bottles, brown bottles and jars, and barrel-shaped containers on the image-right in the foreground and on the side table.

entities.name: pineapple
entities.identification: The group of fruit on the orange-fruit table, with grayish yellow-green oval bodies and gray-green crowns of pointed leaves.

entities.name: smoke and dust near the counter
entities.identification: The reddish-brown and gray translucent smoke and dust around the foreground counter.

entities.name: stacked box-shaped goods
entities.identification: The gray-brown and beige rectangular stacked objects on the counter surfaces on the image-right and elsewhere, with relatively thick box-shaped edges.

entities.name: small light-green table
entities.identification: The light-green wooden table on the near side of the red shop stall, with a rectangular top, slender legs, and a low crossbar.

entities.name: overhead cables
entities.identification: Multiple thin black lines spanning above the buildings.

entities.name: distant person's long gun
entities.identification: The group of dark, slender, elongated firearms raised and held by the armed people near the steps.

entities.name: scattered papers on the ground
entities.identification: The scattered light-gray and off-white pieces of paper on the flagstone ground.

entities.name: shallow puddle in the passageway
entities.identification: The irregular shallow water surfaces and reflective areas in low parts of the passageway.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The person holding a gun who partially enters from the image-left edge, with an arm and hand discernible in frames 15 and 16.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The partial dark-gray firearm extending in from the image-left edge from Person C, with a strong flash at its front in frames 13 through 16.

entities.name: gray button device
entities.identification: The gray rectangular device near the edge of the counter, with a black panel, small buttons, and a light-colored circular component.
